lst.dataset: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (ERA5 reanalysis) temperature_2m_max
lst.note: ERA5 2 m air temperature, not LST; sampled at 0.25° resolution

dem.note: slope = forward difference over 0.01° north and east of cell centre

s5p.dataset: Open-Meteo Air Quality API (CAMS global atmospheric composition forecasts)
s5p.note: CAMS model output, not Sentinel-5P; sampled at 0.4° resolution; aod used instead of aai

sar.dataset: UNOSAT 2022 flood extent via public/data/agaahi/communities.geojson hist_flood_frac_2022
sar.method: mean flooded fraction of community polygons overlapping the cell; null where no community overlaps
